Docs.summary: Computes the FIC (Federated Identity Credential) token-exchange scope from a bare audience.
Docs.remarks: Cloud-specific audiences are stored bare (without /.default); the scope form is computed here so no call site hand-appends the suffix. This type is the single owner of the audience→scope rule.

Docs.param: The bare token-exchange audience URI (e.g., "api://AzureADTokenExchange"), typically read from under .
Docs.summary: Returns the FIC token-exchange scope for a bare audience — the audience with /.default appended — suitable for client-credentials / app-token contexts.
Docs.returns: The audience with /.default appended; the input unchanged if it already ends with /.default; or null if is null or empty.
